correctness.rationale: Changing middle 1 of any 111 triple to 0 cannot destroy any channel distinguishing pair because the two altered blocks of the old word equal isolated symbol 11, and strictly decreases ones. In 111-free words, a differing interior bit would force three consecutive ones on one side to avoid distinguishability. Hence every confusability class is exactly a fiber of π erasing boundary ones next to ones. The fiber representatives R_n are pairwise distinguished and complete. Transfer matrix T on last-two-bit states has characteristic polynomial λ(λ³−λ²−λ−1); checked boundary values yield recurrence at n=5 and Cayley-Hamilton beyond. Independent check: An independent enumeration checked every pair of 111-free words at all lengths n=3..10 against π-equivalence and pairwise separation of all canonical representatives; counts 3,5,9,17,31,57,105,193,355 through n=10. Infinite result rests on the interior-bit argument, not these finite experiments.
